thread:
emma: Heads up @support — customer 'AcmeMaps' on dedicated-prod reported intermittent 504s during embeddings. First seen 2025-11-20T15:42Z. From our api logs: X-Request-Id: 0a1b2c3d-ef45-6789-abcd-000112233445. Model: vicuna-13b-8k-quant. Latency spikes to 8-12s then 504. Pods: inference-vicuna-13b-5f7c9 (node ip-10.0.12.45). Can someone collect pod logs, node dmesg, and GPU metrics? If possible attach a debug bundle to s3://redwood-support-debug/acmemaps/req-0a1b2c3d. Thanks :pray:

mike: ack. @alex oncall can you run repro with the request-id header, capture `kubectl logs -p` and `kubectl describe pod`? Also need `journalctl -u kubelet -n 200` and `dmesg | tail -n 200` from node. Quick repro curl please.

emma: here's a minimal curl we used to reproduce (sanitized):

``
curl -s -D - \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -H "X-Request-Id: 0a1b2c3d-ef45-6789-abcd-000112233445" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  --data '{"input":"embed this"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
``

Response headers include `HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout` and body `{ "error": "upstream timeout" }`

alex: on it. grabbed `kubectl get pods -n dedicated-prod | grep vicuna-13b` -> `inference-vicuna-13b-5f7c9   1/1 Running   0   3h  ... node/ip-10.0.12.45`.

Ran:
``
kubectl logs inference-vicuna-13b-5f7c9 -n dedicated-prod --since=30m > /tmp/inference-vicuna-0a1b2c3d.log
kubectl describe pod inference-vicuna-13b-5f7c9 -n dedicated-prod > /tmp/describe-vicuna-0a1b2c3d.txt
ssh core@10.0.12.45 'sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 500' > /tmp/kubelet-journal-0a1b2c3d.log
ssh core@10.0.12.45 'dmesg | tail -n 200' > /tmp/dmesg-0a1b2c3d.log
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,memory.used,temperature.gpu --format=csv -l 1 -f /tmp/gpu-samp-0a1b2c3d.csv & sleep 15; pkill -f "nvidia-smi"
```

Found repeated `Failed to enqueue kernel` and `GPU reset` entries in kernel log around the same timestamps as the timeouts.

infra-bot: Collected GPU snapshot from node ip-10.0.12.45: avg utilization 95% during spike, mem used 24830 MiB, temp 82C. No ECC errors. Attached metrics -> /var/tmp/gpu-snap-0a1b2c3d.json

mike: good. alex please create a debug bundle (include pods, node logs, gpu csv, request traces) and upload to the support bucket. Use `support-debug-bundle` script.

alex: created bundle id `bundle-20251120-0a1b2c3d` tarball name `bundle-0a1b2c3d.tar.gz`. Uploading to `s3://redwood-support-debug/acmemaps/bundle-0a1b2c3d.tar.gz` (public read=false). cmd:
``
./support-debug-bundle --pods inference-vicuna-13b-5f7c9 --nodes ip-10.0.12.45 --request-id 0a1b2c3d --out /tmp/bundle-0a1b2c3d.tar.gz
aws s3 cp /tmp/bundle-0a1b2c3d.tar.gz s3://redwood-support-debug/acmemaps/bundle-0a1b2c3d.tar.gz
```
Upload done: s3://redwood-support-debug/acmemaps/bundle-0a1b2c3d.tar.gz :thumbsup: 

emma: copying link and sending to customer. Can we set a temporary routing fallback to a smaller model for this customer until we root cause?

mike: done — created policy to route AcmeMaps traffic to vicuna-7b-fallback for 30m starting now. Monitor for errors.

sara: I pulled the bundle and started triage. Initial notes: kernel traces show GPU reset at 15:42:34 UTC, pod logs show repeated `OOMKilled` for process `llama-worker` ~15:42:28 then restart, but GPU memory shows high resident. Adding ticket SUP-7823 and assigning to infra eng. Upload triage notes: https://gist.github.com/redwood/sup-7823-triage

ops-bot: DEBUG-BUNDLE CREATED: id=bundle-20251120-0a1b2c3d, uploaded_to=s3://redwood-support-debug/acmemaps/bundle-0a1b2c3d.tar.gz, size=243MB

sara: follow-ups: please run `kubectl top pod inference-vicuna-13b-5f7c9 -n dedicated-prod --containers` during load next time and attach `nvidia-smi -q` at 1s intervals. Also capture `strace -f -p <pid>` of llama-worker if it happens again. i'll keep SUP-7823 open. :mag:

alex: will add a cronjob to capture 30s pre/post spikes for 24h on that node and attach metrics to the ticket.

emma: thanks everyone. customer updated. marking thread for handoff to infra. :rocket:
